answer: We construct a protocol where each island of identity requires staking collateral tied to a dynamic opportunity-cost bond, functioning as an anchor for trust within the broader decentralized ocean of nodes. By imposing subgame-perfect slashing penalties scaled by the square of concurrent participations, the system ensures that the expected utility of Sybil multiplication remains strictly negative. This mechanism enforces a Nash equilibrium where resource fragmentation is non-profitable, compelling nodes to aggregate capital into singular, high-integrity vectors to maximize yield.
